findings.text: Upheld as advisory (question 5). To call lastFailed, the viewer builds a stand-in UpdateState with an invented attemptAt: null. src/update/report.ts already computes 'failed' from the real state, so the report could carry it as a field. This is duplication, not a defect. The five advisories from round 1 are resolved: one ViewerUpdate declaration, the server's built/failed fields, and checksDaily.

Upheld as advisory. 'line' (the error's first line when the report cannot be built) and 'agents' (the staged binary's absolute path) can carry home-directory paths to the page. The audience is not wider: the route is behind the Host and token checks on the loopback-only viewer, and status/doctor already print the same lines to the same person. The updateReport seam is in-process only, and no request or CLI command sets it.

Lowered to advisory (judge's evidence rule). The reviewer's defect, under question 5: in the unbuilt state the About status line shows a raw system error, 'Not checked: EIO: i/o error, read' (settings-about-unbuilt@1280-dark.png, @360-light.png). It is not upheld as a defect for two reasons. (1) The captures are listed only in the session-written review/ui/manifest.json. review/ui-evidence.json is absent, so they are not evidence that can uphold a ui-ux defect, and a raw error on screen is what a capture shows, so the diff-line branch does not apply. (2) The wording is what spec.md:16 prescribes ('not checked: <the error's first line>'), and AC-8 holds it. Only the spec can change that, not a gate ruling. If the author wants the plain sentence, it is a spec change: amend spec.md:16 and AC-8.

Upheld as advisory. When the report cannot be built, the server sends mode 'check' and fromEnvironment false. checksDaily then shows the switch on and enabled even when the setting is off. This is a narrow fallback state (settings-about-unbuilt@1280-dark.png).
Upheld as advisory. In the off-env state the status line and the switch description say the same thing twice (settings-about-off-env@1280-dark.png, @360-light.png).

Upheld as advisory. In the off state the status line prints the data directory's full env path, which takes five lines at 360 (settings-about-off@360-dark.png, @1280-light.png). Crowding that still holds.
Advisory, debt (outside the change). The 216px projects panel stays open at 768 and 360. The banner no longer depends on it (memories-update-out@768-dark.png, @360-light.png).
Advisory, debt (outside the change). In the light scheme the USwitch off track is barely visible on white cards, across every switch in Settings (settings-about-off-unknown@1280-light.png).
